name: @hbbio/nanoagent
description: Lightweight, purely-functional LLM agent framework for the MCP era.

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: biome check src types test package.json biome.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json
scripts.format: biome check src types test package.json biome.json tsconfig.json tsconfig.build.json --write
scripts.test: bun test src/provider.test.ts src/openrouter.test.ts src/responses.test.ts src/json.test.ts src/schema.test.ts src/message.test.ts src/mcp.test.ts
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run lint && bun run test:types && bun run test
